summary: Verify ProviderContext selectors accept raw 64-character hexadecimal SHA256, preserving spelling. The retained SDD Commands CatalogScaffoldPolicy.parse API at the cited source instead compares its expectedRawDigest with a lowercase sha256:-prefixed digest of the policy byte array. A consumer must first validate the selected raw digest against the captured bytes, then supply the recomputed prefixed representation to the actual codec. ProviderCapabilityAdmission.request consumes independent Policy, selected platform and original descriptor and returns the complete Config ResolutionRequest; parsing or admission establishes declarations, not execution or policy authority. This is immutable source inspection; it supplies no runtime/package qualification, publication or installed acceptance.
title: Verify raw digest selectors require adaptation to the SDD package policy codec
